geeklist.title: Ken's games overflow
geeklist.description:
[bgcolor=#c8ff00]1. Bidding / Starting Bids / BIN[/bgcolor]
All bids must be in whole dollar increments. Some items have a BIN (Buy It Now price). Bidding the BIN price means you win the item instantly. Take 10% off for multiple purchases totaling over $40.
[bgcolor=#c8ff00]2. Shipping & Local pickup options (Please Read)[/bgcolor]
Buyer will pay shipping (US only please) from 97068 [u][b]OR[/b][/u] pick up in West Linn/Wilsonville [u][b]OR[/b][/u] pick up at Newberg Game Con January 31-February 1 (Saturday & Sunday).
When shipping I will use [b]pirateship.com[/b] which allows for discounted shipping rates through UPS and USPS. The total cost will be determined by your zip code, weight and size of the game and on the availability of boxes. Combining games into single shipment may lower per game shipping costs.
[bgcolor=#c8ff00]3. Payment Terms[/bgcolor]
[b][color=#557700][u][bgcolor=#f3f9e6]Payments via PayPal[/bgcolor][/u][/color][/b] if shipped [b][u]OR[/u][/b] Cash if in person exchange. If game will be shipped, please submit payment within 3 days of auction close, otherwise I retain the option to cancel the sale.
[bgcolor=#c8ff00]4. End Time and Date[/bgcolor] This auction will run until [b][color=#557700][u][bgcolor=#f3f9e6]Thursday January 29th.[/bgcolor][/u][/color][/b] The auction will end at some unspecified time in the evening. When the auction has ended, this will be noted in the auction title. It will probably take me a day or two to respond to all winning bids, please be patient.
[bgcolor=#c8ff00]5. Auction Terms[/bgcolor]
Any sales will go through the geek market so that BGG receives their commission. I reserve the right to change auction terms or to remove items for any reason at any time. Some of these items are listed for sale in other locations and may be removed if they sell through those channels. I may also be adding new games during the course of the auction.
geeklist.comment:
WoW seems like something Jordan might like, but he would probably want to try before buying and I get the impression that he doesn't have much money to spare.
Connie or Eric might buy Magic from you, especially at that price, but I don't really know.
I bet Eric would play Prophecy with you at least once. I might be willing to give it a go myself. You just need to bring it with you on Monday unless you think the play time is too long.
Apologize, Hive Pocket was removed due to unforeseen circumstances.
